title: The Resolution Hypothesis: Agent Evolution's Key Is Identifying Improvements
code_status: Project page https://lineshogan.github.io/resolution-hypothesis/ verified in paper; no paper-specific author source repository verified in fixed v1

cost_assessment.basis: Full >10M LLM calls and 400K CPU-core hours explicitly excluded; array-only estimators cheap
cost_assessment.decision: 完整实验成本过高，不复现（审查DONE）；只运行已声明CPU局部机制。

summary: 自进化停滞不一定是提案不够好，可能是一次嘈杂评分分不清候选改进。本文把“同一artifact反复测”的评测噪声与“不同演化run产出不同artifact”的真实质量波动分开。固定artifact的对照只受前者限制，方法排名同时受两者限制。
fidelity_note: variance_components执行附录B.2的两个估计，返回负的run_variance_unbiased与仅截断的run_sd，要求至少2×2平衡有限数值矩阵。输入必须是已经测量且来源明确的结果；模块不生成agent轨迹、不选择候选，也不伪造方差置信区间或powered superiority。
